# Vendored frontend dependencies

Select2 is the only frontend library MarketTracker owns. Alliance Auth 5
supplies jQuery through its base template and Chart.js through its reusable
``bundles/chart-js.html`` template bundle.

| Asset | Version | Upstream | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Select2 CSS | 4.0.13 | <https://select2.org/> | `15d6ad4dfdb43d0affad683e70029f97a8f8fc8637a28845009ee0542dccdf81` |
| Select2 JavaScript | 4.0.13 | <https://select2.org/> | `00501810e93307a8882a74d864e7547fd1458deea539361dc1124ac133799a4b` |

The matching upstream license texts are stored alongside the assets. Update
the versions, hashes, templates, and license files together.
